```yaml
name: Main Build

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - camel-4.10.x
      - camel-4.14.x

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up JDK 21
        uses: actions/setup-java@be666c2fcd27ec809703dec50e508c2fdc7f6654 # v5.2.0
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: 21
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: mvn build
        run: ./mvnw -B -V -D'http.keepAlive=false' -l build.log -D'maven.wagon.http.pool=false' -D'maven.wagon.httpconnectionManager.ttlSeconds=120' --no-transfer-progress -Dquickly install
      - name: Archive logs
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@bbbca2ddaa5d8feaa63e36b76fdaad77386f024f # v7.0.0
        if: always()
        with:
          name: build.log
          path: build.log
          retention-days: 2
```

yaml:
name: Main Build

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - camel-4.10.x
      - camel-4.14.x

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up JDK 21
        uses: actions/setup-java@be666c2fcd27ec809703dec50e508c2fdc7f6654 # v5.2.0
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: 21
          cache: 'maven'
      - name: mvn build
        run: ./mvnw -B -V -D'http.keepAlive=false' -l build.log -D'maven.wagon.http.pool=false' -D'maven.wagon.httpconnectionManager.ttlSeconds=120' --no-transfer-progress -Dquickly install
      - name: Archive logs
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@bbbca2ddaa5d8feaa63e36b76fdaad77386f024f # v7.0.0
        if: always()
        with:
          name: build.log
          path: build.log
          retention-days: 2
